properties.assessment: Road traffic exposure is a screening question at nearby settlements.
properties.mitigation: Select upwind and downwind sites before designing controls.
properties.measurement: Measure seasonal PM2.5 and PM10 at paired locations and record traffic counts.

properties.assessment: Steep slopes and construction disturbance warrant review before assigning erosion risk.
properties.mitigation: Inspect stabilized cut slopes and drainage outfalls before monsoon.
properties.measurement: Log exposed soil cover and outfall turbidity before and after rainfall.

properties.assessment: A land-cover comparison can screen for canopy change near the road corridor.
properties.mitigation: Check compensatory planting survival and restore temporary work areas.
properties.measurement: Classify pre- and post-construction land cover using comparable seasonal imagery and field checks.

properties.assessment: Construction dust is a plausible source of short-term particulate exposure in the screening framework.
properties.mitigation: Document road watering and protective covers where justified by the monitoring plan.
properties.measurement: Compare particulate levels near haul roads with a background location.

properties.assessment: Road embankments and drainage changes are a screening concern where runoff reaches cultivated land.
properties.mitigation: Review culvert capacity and erosion protection with field observations.
properties.measurement: Survey drainage paths and check sediment deposition downstream of outlets.

properties.assessment: National Board for Wildlife minutes record a habitat-improvement condition for a specific package near the Karanja–Sohol sanctuary.
properties.mitigation: Track habitat improvement against the condition for that package.
properties.measurement: Use the approved package boundary and documentary evidence to verify measures.
